title: HumanStudy study card v1 (study.json)
description: The catalogue entry for one study: what paper it is, which protocol file (by canonical sha256) is the study, how far it has been checked, and whether its content may be released. One file per study directory, next to protocol.json. Read by desktop, web, cloud, Bench and the website.

id.description: equals protocol.json id and the directory name

doi.description: bare DOI (10.xxxx/…), null when the paper has none

version.description: the study's own semver: major = a change that alters what participants see or how it is scored

quality.description: draft = built, checks not passing or not run; checked = hsenv.checks PASS; high_fidelity = checks PASS and an independent fidelity review signed it off

quality_evidence.description: paths to the review files behind the quality level (review/checks-*.json, review/fidelity-review-*.md)

release_hold.description: non-null = runnable for private research only; the reason (e.g. materials licence not stated in the PDF). Never publish content while set

path.description: relative to this file, normally protocol.json

sha256.description: sha256 of the canonical JSON (json.dumps(data, sort_keys=True)); first 16 hex = hsenv Protocol.version

schema_version.description: the protocol's schema_version ('1'; 'legacy' for a pre-v1 protocol)

paper.description: the paper this study replays (catalogue paper id or a {title, doi} object)

paperId.description: the catalogue paper id (paper_<hex>) once indexed

contributors.description: people credited for the study (Bench CI matches a PR author against github)

visibility.description: public = may be released; private = runnable for private research only

hsenv.description: engine version range this study needs, e.g. '>=0.8,<0.9'

fidelity.description: the independent fidelity verdict behind quality high_fidelity: verdict, review file, who signed it

arms.description: arm summary written by study sync from protocol.json (never hand-edited)

release.description: where a public release came from: {slug, private_commit, projection_sha}
